diversity_mean6_tcn.members: nn_pca_s1729 + nn_pca_s1730 + nn_pca_s1731 + nn_minimal + nn_standard + tcn24

diversity_trimmed_mean6.members: nn_pca_s1729 + nn_pca_s1730 + nn_pca_s1731 + nn_minimal + nn_standard + tcn24
diversity_trimmed_mean6.rule: equal mean after dropping per-event worst member

diversity_top3_train.rule: equal mean of top-3 by train-side (311-320) MAPE

train_selected_blend_w0.50.rule: w=0.50 chosen on train 311-320 (in-sample LOO-scoring approximation)

selection.method: members fitted once on all 315 events; blend weight picked by event-balanced MAPE on in-sample predictions of training events 311-320 (cheap approximation of leave-one-out refit)

limitations: Four previously inspected validation events (321-324); descriptive grids are not fresh tests
Train-side selection scores in-sample predictions of 311-320 (members saw those labels), not a true leave-one-out refit
Rows within an event are dependent; event count (4) limits precision
Raised-objective variant was designed for the stream LLM family; here it only rescales the case-feature JointNet weights
